title: P26: directory decode accepts any placeholder names
description: protocol-06 §5.1 shows {targetUser}/{requesterUser} for consent endpoints; §5.7 and P1 (mimid-1wgh.5.16) use {targetDomain}/{requesterDomain}. Readings: (a) require the expected placeholder names when decoding a directory; (b) accept any valid RFC 6570 level-1 template and fail at expand() when the variable does not match. Chosen: (b), lenient decode: a peer that copies §5.1 literally still decodes, and a mismatch fails closed at expansion (P25).
